summary: Iter 20 - TuneIn (real OPML) + Spotify (demo-mode) + WS66i streaming modules. Backend pytest 25/25 PASS. Auth gating verified for /api/tunein/*, /api/spotify/{status,login,library}, /api/stream/*/play_station|play_spotify (401 without Bearer); /api/spotify/callback is PUBLIC and returns 400 HTML 'Spotify sign-in failed' with bad/missing state. TuneIn: /saved returns 7 pre-saved stations (WFAN Sports Radio 66/101.9 kind=url with Audacy URL + ESPN Radio, FOX Sports, NBC Sports, Bloomberg Radio, CNBC, Bloomberg TV); search?q=jazz hits real opml.radiotime.com and returns 40 stations all with guide_id starting 's'; browse/sports & /music return categories; browse/c57940 returns stations; browse/bad -> 400; POST /saved with guide_id=s34682 adds and DELETE removes; POST with url=ftp://x -> 400. Play station: POST /stream/stream_a/play_station {station_id:'wfan', zones:['audio_living']} logs Linkplay 'play TuneIn url' simulated and sets stream status to play with title 'WFAN Sports Radio 66 / 101.9'; {guide_id:'s165740'} works; unknown -> 404. Spotify: status.configured false, connected false, redirect_uri http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/spotify/callback; /login -> 400 with 'Client ID'; /library -> 400 'not connected'; play_spotify bad uri -> 400; valid playlist URI in demo -> simulated OK. PUT /api/config spotify {client_id:'x', client_secret:'y'} -> response masks secret as '__stored__'; status.configured becomes true; /login returns auth_url to accounts.spotify.com with state=; restored to '' at end. Presets: new step types tunein_station & spotify_play validate correctly; unknown station id -> 400; invalid Spotify URI -> 400; running the preset logs 'TuneIn' + 'spotify play' Linkplay entries. Frontend (390x844, demo bypass): Listen tab -> stream-module-stream_a card visible; stream-open-stream_a opens stream-sheet-stream_a with stream-tabs (fav/tunein/spotify). TuneIn: default cat=saved shows tunein-station-wfan + 6 others; tunein-search-input 'jazz' + tunein-search-btn returned 40 real stations; tunein-cat-sports drilled into 22 tunein-sub-* chips. Picking WFAN + zone chip audio_living + stream-play-btn-stream_a triggered play; card title updated to 'WFAN Sports Radio 66 / 101.9'. Spotify tab shows spotify-not-connected panel. Settings (via open-settings-btn): settings-spotify card has spotify-status-text='Not connected', spotify-client-id-input, spotify-client-secret-input (type=password), spotify-connect-btn shows toast containing 'Client ID' when clicked empty. Scenes: new-preset-btn opens preset-builder; step type dropdown has 9 options including 'Play TuneIn station' and 'Play Spotify playlist'; tunein_station -> value select of 7 saved stations; spotify_play -> text input placeholder 'spotify:playlist:… (connect Spotify to pick)'. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

issues: TuneIn CDN image URLs returned by opml.radiotime.com use http:// (http://cdn-profiles.tunein.com/... and http://cdn-radiotime-logos.tunein.com/...). Chromium auto-upgrades them to HTTPS so they render, but every station emits a 'Mixed Content' console warning. Consider rewriting cdn-profiles/cdn-radiotime-logos URLs to https:// in music.py (_station/_links) or at render time to silence the warnings.

action_items: Optional polish: upgrade TuneIn image URLs to https:// to eliminate Chromium Mixed-Content console warnings (functional pass, cosmetic only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/stream/{sid}/play_station still returns 200 for a guide_id request even if the device is in demo mode AND linkplay cannot resolve the station (resolve runs only when _stream_live is true). Fine for demo; however the station dict built from {guide_id:req.guide_id, name:req.name or req.guide_id} is NEVER inserted into tunein_saved, so repeat plays by the same guide_id log a fresh simulated entry each time — correct behaviour but easy to forget; a short code comment would help.

music.py _flatten only accepts guide_id starting with 's'; podcasts/shows (t*/p*) are intentionally filtered out — this is correct for a radio-only use case, but the filter is implicit. Add a one-liner docstring.

music.py resolve() returns the first audio URL from Tune.ashx; some stations return multiple bitrates (hls + mp3). Picking the first can land on an HLS .m3u8 that LinkPlay firmware doesn't play. Consider preferring mime=audio/mpeg or lowest bitrate for compatibility.

server.py stream_play_spotify uses st.get('spotify_name') or st['name'] as the Spotify Connect device target; current demo WS66I_STREAMERS have no 'spotify_name' field, so the human-readable 'Sound Amplifier' will be matched against the user's Spotify Connect device list. Document that the operator must either rename their speaker in Spotify to match or set spotify_name per streamer in config.

server.py line 1456 (spotify_callback): wrapping music.run(sp.me) is fine, but if Spotify returns 403 (free user token with no product field) the stored premium flag can be None rather than False — downstream play_on error message says 'Premium is required' which is correct, but spotify_status 'premium' field may surface as null in the UI. Normalise with bool(me.get('product') == 'premium').

PresetBuilder.jsx: spotify_play step requires the user to type a full spotify:playlist:xxx URI when Spotify isn't connected; there is no client-side URI shape validation before 'Save', so invalid URIs only error at POST time. Consider a simple regex check in the input to disable 'Save' until the URI matches.

StreamPanel.jsx: tunein-save-{guide_id} bookmark button is only rendered inside StationRow when `saved` prop is defined; in TuneInBrowser's search results path it is passed, in saved-tab path it isn't -- works as designed but worth a comment.
test_credentials: PIN 1234 or demo bypass (used demo for frontend).
seed_data_creation: TEST_tunein_spotify_vol preset created+run+deleted in-test (no residue). s34682 Jazz24 added+removed from tunein_saved. Spotify client_id/secret temporarily set to 'x'/'y' then restored to ''. preset_living_tv_sound default preset preserved and present in final /api/scenes list. 7 default stations intact at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter20_tunein_spotify.py -v -o addopts= . Covers TuneIn real-OPML CRUD+browse+search, Spotify demo-mode gating + config masking + OAuth URL build, Linkplay simulated play_station/play_spotify, and preset validation of new tunein_station/spotify_play step types. Existing iter19 (/pins, Sony keys) & iter18 (presets+streams) suites still relevant. UI entry points: Listen > stream-open-stream_a > stream-tab-tunein | stream-tab-spotify; Settings via open-settings-btn > settings-spotify; Scenes > new-preset-btn > preset-builder. Note: TuneIn CDN URLs are http:// causing Mixed-Content warnings (functional, cosmetic). Spotify Connect device match uses WS66i streamer 'name' unless 'spotify_name' is set in config.amp.streamers.
rca of the issue: N/A — zero functional defects. One cosmetic design observation (http:// TuneIn image URLs trigger Chromium Mixed-Content auto-upgrade warnings in console). Several code-quality suggestions in critical_code_review_comments.
